description: This file defines classes, enums, and constants related to OpenType font table parsing within the PDFsharp library, including character mappings, font metrics, color tables, and other font-related structures.

classes.name: CMap4
classes.description: Represents a format 4 character map segment mapping to delta values, used for Unicode character mapping in fonts.

classes.name: CMap12
classes.description: Represents a format 12 segment mapping for character codes to glyph indices based on grouped ranges.

classes.name: CMapTable
classes.description: Contains and manages different character map formats (formats 4 and 12), and selects suitable encoding schemes for the font.

classes.name: ColorTable
classes.description: Defines color layering information for multi-layered glyphs, including methods to retrieve layer details.

classes.name: ColorPalletTable
classes.description: Stores palettes of colors used in color glyphs, with support for multiple palettes and entries.

classes.name: FontHeaderTable
classes.description: Houses global font information, including bounding box, units per em, and other metrics.

classes.name: HorizontalHeaderTable
classes.description: Contains horizontal font layout information such as ascent, descent, and line gap.

classes.name: HorizontalMetrics
classes.description: Represents individual horizontal glyph metrics: advance width and left side bearing.

classes.name: HorizontalMetricsTable
classes.description: Collection of horizontal metrics for font glyphs, with logic to read metrics from font data.

classes.name: VerticalHeaderTable
classes.description: Contains vertical font metrics analogous to HorizontalHeaderTable, but for vertical layout.

classes.name: VerticalMetrics
classes.description: Represents individual vertical glyph metrics: advance width and left side bearing.

classes.name: VerticalMetricsTable
classes.description: Collection of vertical metrics, not fully implemented in PDFsharp.

classes.name: MaximumProfileTable
classes.description: Defines maximum profile data about font complexity and glyph count.

classes.name: NameTable
classes.description: Handles retrieval of font name strings such as font family, style, and full font name.

classes.name: OS2Table
classes.description: Contains font metrics, style bits, Unicode range, and vendor info, including methods to determine style traits.

classes.name: PostScriptTable
classes.description: Houses PostScript-related font information, including italic angle and pitch.

classes.name: ControlValueTable
classes.description: Holds font control values used in TrueType instructions.

classes.name: FontProgram
classes.description: Stores the instructions (bytecode) for the font's TrueType hinting program.

classes.name: ControlValueProgram
classes.description: Contains the set of instructions executed for font hinting and adjustments.

classes.name: GlyphSubstitutionTable
classes.description: Placeholder for glyph substitution info; methods not implemented.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and parses font table data from the font source, specific to each table class.
